topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I always thought I knew him well, through and through. We laughed together, confided in each other, and I trusted him with the weights of my world. And yet, the ground has shifted beneath me. Everyone at the office greets him with nods and smiles, but I see the cracks now. He spoke of his job with such pride, but the details don’t add up, the stories don’t match. I can’t shake the image of him, laughing, as I stumbled upon the truth. How do I look him in the eye again, knowing he's built this façade? What part of him, if any, was real?
